title: Quentin and the Verdict
author: Ulyana Galloway
blurb: Ada Iversen, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
